scope.summary: Implement the channel stacking evaluator with volume-preservation post-pass per Section 13.17 (BK-17.2, TAI-BK-035), closing REQ-007: ordered evaluation (skeletal channels -> tissue morph stack -> volume-preservation post-pass (delta-mush class, on by default, per-channel opt-out) -> correctives hook -> soft-tissue hook), deterministic for a given (base_mesh_version, channel map, seed) triple.
acceptance_criteria: evaluate_body(base_mesh, registry, channel_map) applies stages in the normative order: (1) skeletal, (2) tissue sparse-delta accumulation from all active multi-key tracks, (3) volume-preservation post-pass, (4) correctives hook (no-op until 13.19 lands), (5) soft-tissue hook (no-op until 13.20 lands); stage order is encoded as a typed pipeline, not comments.

Volume-preservation post-pass (delta-mush class smoothing of stacking artifacts) is enabled by default and per-channel opt-out via a registry flag; a fixture with two overlapping-region-adjacent extreme channels shows measurably reduced collapse (surface self-intersection count) with the pass on vs off.
Evaluation is deterministic: identical (base_mesh_version, channel map, seed) input produces bit-identical vertex output across two runs in the same test.
Evaluating an empty channel map returns the neutral base mesh unchanged (identity test).
scope.risk_if_missed: Linear delta stacking without volume correction is why stacked Daz morphs collapse at extremes (REQ-007); without this evaluator the operator's stacked archetypes (petite + max volume everywhere) are structurally unreachable.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
